description: This file defines the class RelatedListViewSession, which manages session data related to 'Related List' views in a vtiger CRM module. It provides methods for adding, removing, and retrieving related modules, as well as handling pagination state within user sessions.

classes.name: RelatedListViewSession
classes.description: Class managing session state for related list views, including related modules and pagination info.

methods.name: RelatedListViewSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing RelatedListViewSession instance, setting default module and starting page.

methods.name: addRelatedModuleToSession
methods.description: Static method to add a related module to the session storage for the current module.

methods.name: removeRelatedModuleFromSession
methods.description: Static method to remove a related module from the session for the current module.

methods.name: getRelatedModulesFromSession
methods.description: Retrieves list of related modules stored in session for the current module.

methods.name: saveRelatedModuleStartPage
methods.description: Stores the current start page for a related module in session data.

methods.name: getCurrentPage
methods.description: Retrieves the current page number for a related module from session data.

methods.name: getRequestStartPage
methods.description: Determines the start page from the request parameters, defaulting to 1.

methods.name: getRequestCurrentPage
methods.description: Calculates the current page based on request data, handling 'last' keyword and validation.
